needs: historical consensus draft rankings (NHL Central Scouting, Elite Prospects, McKenzie etc)
NHL:nhl.draft_remaining_board_state.limiting_source_or_reason: Public ranking archives/EliteProspects/NHL.com, scraped and encoded; dated historic ranking snapshots partly via Wayback
NHL:nhl.draft_remaining_board_state.notes: No NHL ledger exists. Rank dispersion across outlets needs scraping; old snapshots patchy. Simulation itself is model code.

NHL:nhl.gm_candidate_pool.limiting_source_or_reason: TSN/Sportsnet/NHL.com free reports; must be captured with timestamps
NHL:nhl.gm_candidate_pool.notes: Candidate-report vintages cannot be backfilled faithfully; Athletic paywalled but free outlets cover it. Prospective capture, tiny n.

NHL:nhl.zone_start_share.limiting_source_or_reason: NHL stats REST (skater percentages zoneStartPct) and Natural Stat Trick, free
NHL:nhl.zone_start_share.notes: Free, multi-season; needs pulling and prior-game cutoff aggregation.

NHL:nhl.opening_shift_deployment.notes: Historical shifts back to ~2010 available; actual starting lines pregame only inferable from prior games (lineup news prospective).

NHL:nhl.award_vote_share_model.limiting_source_or_reason: Hockey-Reference award voting pages and NHL awards archive, free
NHL:nhl.award_vote_share_model.notes: Small sample (one vote per award per year); sources free but must be scraped.

NHL:nhl.award_voting_rules.limiting_source_or_reason: NHL.com award pages, PHWA/NHLPA pages, free
NHL:nhl.award_voting_rules.notes: Static facts hand-encoded; no time series. Some ballots published (PHWA) but not needed.

NHL:nhl.coach_expectation_delta.notes: All free and historical; in-house expectation is model-computed after pull.

NHL:nhl.period_penalty_intensity_balance.limiting_source_or_reason: NHL api-web play-by-play + game summaries, free
NHL:nhl.period_penalty_intensity_balance.notes: Pull and encode; crew pregame assignment published day-of.

NHL:nhl.officials.limiting_source_or_reason: NHL game summaries/play-by-play, Scouting the Refs, free
NHL:nhl.officials.notes: Free history; officials' names announced game day so pregame-usable.

NHL:m.trade_tape.notes: Executed trade prices/sides are market data; benchmark not market-free input.

MLB:m.trade_tape.notes: Executed trade prices/sides are market data; benchmark not market-free input.

NHL:m.orderbook_depth.notes: Order book is market data; history also not available.

MLB:m.quote_history.notes: Kalshi quote series is a price benchmark.

needs: game status/delay start-end from StatsAPI feed
MLB:mlb.delay_starter_removal.limiting_source_or_reason: MLB StatsAPI feed, Retrosheet notes, Open-Meteo historical forecast, free
MLB:mlb.delay_starter_removal.notes: Delay events are rare; need live feed pull (not in boxscore ledger). Forecast vintages via Open-Meteo historical-forecast okay.

MLB:mlb.team_wrc_vs_hand.limiting_source_or_reason: Baseball Savant/pybaseball and StatsAPI splits (free); FanGraphs may block scraping
MLB:mlb.team_wrc_vs_hand.notes: Lineups in schedule ledger but no split data; pull Statcast and compute wRC+ proxies.

MLB:mlb.player_involvement_mention_rate.limiting_source_or_reason: No free historical broadcast transcript source; MLB.TV audio paid, 'own transcripts' do not exist
MLB:mlb.player_involvement_mention_rate.notes: Target (what broadcasters say) lacks free public archive; prospective own-ASR of licensed streams not free/public. Involvement side is available via StatsAPI.

MLB:mlb.remaining_sos.notes: Schedule ledger covers 11 seasons incl. future games within season; talent posteriors derivable from results in same ledger.

needs: player career/season stats for milestone proximity
MLB:mlb.game_narrative_triggers.limiting_source_or_reason: StatsAPI feed and press notes free; live-only aspects (injuries, weather) need prospective capture
MLB:mlb.game_narrative_triggers.notes: Triggers occur in-game, so only usable as pre-game hazard via milestone proximity; broadcast linkage lacks transcripts.

MLB:mlb.pitch_type_whiff.notes: Free pitch-level since 2008; not in current ledgers; large pull.

MLB:mlb.season_feat_ledger_state.notes: Ledger stops at 2025-09-28 with sparse boxscore fields; current-season state must be pulled; hit-distance coverage unverified.
